articles.title: Oil Price Today (November 27): Brent crude above $96 as Houthis target Saudi refinery in fresh attack. What are experts saying?
articles.description: Crude oil price : Crude oil prices are slightly lower as they remain above the $96 mark during Friday trading. The decline follows recent attacks on Saudi Arabian oil refineries that raised concerns about supply disruptions. An attack in Jazan resulted in the death of a worker and the halting of operations. Goldman Sachs predicts a considerable rise in oil prices amid ongoing geopolitical tensions and potential production shortfalls.
